WITH status_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    brokrepstat,
    AVG(modelconf) as status_avg
  FROM compliancecase
  GROUP BY brokrepstat
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(modelconf) as baseline_val
  FROM compliancecase
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT sa.brokrepstat, sa.status_avg
  FROM status_avgs sa, baseline b
  WHERE sa.status_avg > b.baseline_val
),
mean_qualifying AS (
  SELECT AVG(status_avg) as mean_val
  FROM qualifying
)
SELECT 
  q.brokrepstat,
  q.status_avg,
  q.status_avg - b.baseline_val as diff_from_baseline,
  q.status_avg / mq.mean_val as ratio_to_mean
FROM qualifying q, baseline b, mean_qualifying mq
WHERE b.baseline_val IS NOT NULL
  AND mq.mean_val IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY q.brokrepstat
